name: @mwaeckerlin/openclaw-mcp-gateway
description: MCP server to give SSH-sandboxed AI agents limited access to the OpenClaw Gateway API.

scripts.test: npm run test:docs && npm run test:unit && npm run test:image && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:image: npm run build && bash tests/image-contract.sh mwaeckerlin/openclaw-mcp-gateway
scripts.test:e2e: node test/generate-pairing.mjs && (cd test && docker compose up --build --force-recreate --remove-orphans --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from test-client)
